`chat.js` epoch fix: `reset()` clears the panel only when `watching === null`. If a session was already attached, `attach()` still does the clear on change. This is sound, but nothing tests the case of a late `Session.resume` join landing after reset, so only the `Session.start` path is proven by `new-session.mjs`.
